Method of Attack: Bundled with a rootkit component that hides the malicious process’ presence from monitoring tools
Capable of updating and upgrading itself and its configuration file
Installed via executable that downloads and executes shell scripts to install miner and rootkit
Rootkit hides the miner process to avoid detection despite high CPU usage
Attack Vector: Unofficial or compromised plugin such as media-streaming software
Indicators of Compromise: /tmp/kworkerds process utilizing 100% CPU when rootkit not installed
High CPU utilization with no visible process when rootkit installed
